rules.rule: GFC frontend review. File real bugs introduced or directly worsened by the diff: crashes, wrong data shown to users, broken forecast/monitor/verify behavior, auth/premium-gate bypasses, security issues, plus React 19 correctness (stale closures, wrong hook deps, setState during render), Redux/Immer misuse, OpenLayers mistakes (projection, layer leaks, unremoved listeners), and null/undefined derefs on weather data with evidence in the diff. Report only medium-or-higher issues. Suppress low-severity, style, nitpick, and polish findings entirely. Require evidence (file, line, diff evidence, concrete user impact) for every finding; do not file claims you cannot evidence. Do NOT propose new features, abstractions, refactors, or follow-up work. Do NOT expand to untouched code or hypothetical edge cases without evidence in this diff. Max 10 findings per PR, most severe first. Each finding needs file, line, evidence in the diff, and concrete user impact.

GFC component review. File real bugs in the diff that break rendering, input, or user understanding: crashes, broken controls, inaccessible critical actions with no workaround, wrong copy that causes user error, controlled/uncontrolled input mistakes, responsive breakage on realistic screens. Suppress low-severity, style, nitpick, and polish findings entirely. Report only medium-or-higher issues. No style taste, no memoization/render micro-opts unless they cause visible breakage, no new-feature ideas. Do not expand to untouched components. Max 10 findings per PR.

GFC backend review. File real bugs in touched routes: missing auth checks, injection, secret/PII leaks, unvalidated client payloads that cause crashes or bad writes, broken Stripe webhook verification, error paths that leak internals or silently fail user-visible operations. Suppress low-severity, style, nitpick, and polish findings entirely. Report only medium-or-higher issues. No style nits, no refactor proposals, no speculative hardening without evidence. Treat auth, injection, or secret-handling gaps as critical. Each finding needs file, line, evidence, and user impact.

GFC automation review. Report only medium-or-higher bugs that break the script on realistic inputs: shell injection via PR titles/branch names, wrong gh api usage that fails, missing pagination that drops data, stale-SHA races, or secrets leaking into logs. Suppress low-severity, style, nitpick, and polish findings entirely. No feature suggestions.

GFC workflow review. File real safety and correctness bugs: execution of untrusted PR code via pull_request_target checkout, unpinned third-party actions on non-immutable refs, permissions wider than the job needs, secrets from anywhere but secrets context or echoed to logs, concurrency groups that cancel the parallel reviewer, missing timeouts on network-dependent jobs. Suppress low-severity, style, nitpick, and hygiene findings entirely. Report only medium-or-higher issues. Critical only for genuine execution/privilege-escalation risks.

Docs review. Report only medium-or-higher correctness issues where touched docs materially misstate behavior or give a command that causes a user-visible failure. Suppress low-severity, stale-link, style, nitpick, and prose-quality findings; do not rewrite prose for taste.

GFC test-value review. These tests were admitted to review explicitly, so judge whether each test earns its lines: flag tests with no meaningful assertion (only mocks, snapshots of nothing, tautologies), tests that cannot fail, tests duplicating coverage already present in the diff, and excessive mock scaffolding that tests the mocks instead of the code. Suppress low-severity, style, nitpick, and polish findings entirely. Report only medium-or-higher issues, including hollow tests that give false confidence on a critical path (forecast correctness, auth, premium gates, payments). Do not demand tests for trivial code and do not propose new test files or frameworks.

GFC changelog review. This file was admitted to review explicitly. Report only medium-or-higher correctness issues where an entry materially misstates or contradicts the code diff. Suppress low-severity, style, nitpick, and prose-quality findings.
